map.honesty: Forecast from the last VARUNA run at {time}; updates every 5 minutes
map.honestyEmpty: No VARUNA run yet; the map fills after the first run
map.honestyError: The forecast did not load; check the connection and reload
map.honestyLoading: Loading the forecast from the last VARUNA run
map.noStreetsDescription: The public map fills after the first run.
map.saveUnavailable: Available once a run has scored the streets around you
map.saveHint: Save a location to get its passable-until time first.
map.saveUnavailableHint: Available once a run has scored the streets around you.

report.title: Report water
report.description: Three steps: where you are, a photo if you have one, and how deep the water is. Your report improves the next forecast for the streets around you.
report.honesty: Reports reach Pulse in the next cycle
report.whereDescription: Use your location, or type the coordinates.
report.noGeolocation: This browser does not share a location. Type the latitude and longitude instead.
report.locationUnavailable: Location unavailable ({reason}). Type the latitude and longitude instead.
report.photoDescription: Optional - a photo helps us read the depth.
report.depthDescription: Pick the closest of the three.
report.pickDepth: Pick a depth to send the report.
report.queuedFallback: Your report is queued; the next cycle assimilates it.
report.queuedFollowUp: Once assimilated it appears on the drain X-ray as an observation with the blockage change it caused.
report.improved: Thanks - your report improved the forecast for {count, plural, one {# street} other {# streets}}
report.improvedBody: Pulse assimilated your report. It appears on the drain X-ray as an observation with the blockage change it caused.
report.assimilatedBody: Pulse assimilated your report and no street forecast moved by more than 3 cm. It still appears on the drain X-ray as an observation.
report.savedOfflineBody: The phone is offline, so the report has not reached VARUNA yet and has not changed any forecast. It will be sent when the phone is back online.
report.photoUse: If you add a photo, it is stored with your report and shown to the ward officer and on the citizen dashboard.
report.photoReady: Ready to send at {width} × {height} px, without the location and camera details stored inside the file.
report.photoTooBig: This photo is {mb} MB, over the 15 MB limit, so it was not used. Pick a smaller photo or send the report without one.
report.photoUnreadable: This browser could not open that photo, so it was not used. Some phones save photos as HEIC, which older browsers cannot read. Pick another photo or send the report without one.
report.photoStillTooBig: This photo is still too large to send after resizing, so it was not used. Pick another photo or send the report without one.
report.noteHint: Shown with your report to the ward officer and on the citizen dashboard. Leave out names and phone numbers.
report.photoStored: Your photo is stored with the report.
report.photoNotStored: Your photo was not stored. The report was kept without it.
report.photoNotConfirmed: This server did not say whether it kept your photo.
report.photoSavedOffline: Your photo is saved on this phone with the report.
